docRequirement: A `UserPromptSubmit` hook may rename the session by returning `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` — whats-new/2026-w15.md:115 "`UserPromptSubmit` hooks can set the session title via `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle`", corroborated by the primary reference: hooks.md:1198 § *UserPromptSubmit decision control* lists "`sessionTitle` | Sets the session title. Use to name sessions automatically based on the prompt content" in the event's output-field table, with the JSON example at :1205-1209 placing it inside `hookSpecificOutput` alongside `hookEventName: "UserPromptSubmit"`. The field name is exactly `sessionTitle` (camelCase) and it is nested, never top-level. hooks.md:969 adds the host-side rule the feature implies: an explicitly set title is not to be silently overwritten.
current: The field is parsed nowhere, carried nowhere and consumed nowhere; `grep -ran 'sessionTitle' packages/ apps/` returns five lines, all the unrelated React prop `sessionTitle` in `apps/viewer/src/App.tsx:202` and `apps/viewer/src/components/Header.tsx:11,17,32,34`. Four layers each drop it independently. (1) PARSE — `parseHookCommandOutput` (packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.ts:313-407) reads exactly `permissionDecision` (:336), the PermissionRequest `decision.{behavior,interrupt,updatedPermissions,updatedInput,message}` band (:343-373), `permissionDecisionReason` (:362), `additionalContext` (:368), `updatedInput` (:370), `retry` (:378), `worktreePath` (:385), `updatedToolOutput` (:388) and the elicitation pair `action`/`content` (:395-401); there is no unknown-key passthrough, so `sessionTitle` never enters the decision object. `parseUniversalHookOutput` (:443-454) reads only the five universal fields. (2) TYPE — `PreToolUseDecision` (packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:336-386) has no `sessionTitle` key, so `HookDecisionField = keyof PreToolUseDecision` (hook-decision-contract.ts:37) cannot even name it. (3) PROJECTION — `parseHookOutputForEvent` (hook-command.ts:464-483) projects through `projectHookDecisionForEvent` (hook-decision-contract.ts:306-325), which copies only `surface.fields`; `UserPromptSubmit` is a `top-level` event (hook-decision-contract.ts:40-50, the name at :41) and falls through `surfaceFor`'s switch to the shared default at :161-163, whose surface is `{decisionValues: BLOCK_VALUES, fields: ['reason','additionalContext']}`. (4) MERGE — `mergePreToolUseDecisionObjects` (packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:1773-1818) rebuilds an explicit allowlist object at :1809-1817, so any field not named there is also lost whenever two hooks match one event or a native and a plugin result combine (`mergeExecutionResults`:1747). Consumers correspondingly read `additionalContext` and `reason` and nothing else on this event: `pi-agent.ts:6414-6438` (`runPiPromptGate`, the only place a Pi verdict can still act, per its own comment at :6400-6413), `codex-agent.ts:455-470`, `nestor-cloud-agent.ts:267-277`, and the Claude-SDK bridge `plugins/hooks-automation.ts:1696-1704`. The rename MECHANISM exists and is unwired: `SessionManager.renameSession` (packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:14112-14127) sets `managed.name`, persists, emits `title_generated` and pokes the session-partition watcher.
divergence: Whole mechanism absent, not a misnamed key: `sessionTitle` has no type field, no parse, no per-event surface entry, no merge entry and no consumer, so a documented UserPromptSubmit output is silently discarded four times over. The rename target it needs (`renameSession`) and its renderer wire event (`title_generated`, packages/shared/src/protocol/dto.ts:373) both already exist, so this is a missing wire between two present halves rather than a missing product. Second delta, host-side: even once wired, `SessionManager.generateTitle` overwrites `managed.name` unconditionally when its async LLM title returns (SessionManager.ts:17619-17628), so a hook title set during the first turn would be clobbered seconds later — hooks.md:969's "avoid overwriting a title the user set explicitly" has no counterpart flag in `ManagedSession` (SessionManager.ts:1172).

change.what: Add `sessionTitle?: string` to `PreToolUseDecision`, doc-commented as UserPromptSubmit + SessionStart only (hooks.md:1198 and :990). This is what makes `'sessionTitle'` a legal `HookDecisionField`. Separately decide the Claude-SDK half: `SdkAutomationCallbackResult.hookSpecificOutput` (:911-916) currently allows only `updatedInput`/`additionalContext`/`updatedToolOutput`; widening it forwards the field to the Claude SDK, which renames ITS session, not the fork's record — see blastRadius before doing it.

One line, next to the `updatedToolOutput` read at :388-389: `if (typeof hookSpecificOutput?.sessionTitle === 'string') decision.sessionTitle = hookOutputField(hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle);`. Read it ONLY from `hookSpecificOutput` — hooks.md's example (:1205-1209) never puts it at the top level, unlike `additionalContext`/`updatedInput` which are read from both. `hookOutputField` (:201-204) gives redaction plus the documented 10,000-char cap; title-length trimming belongs at the consumer, not here.

Add an explicit `case 'UserPromptSubmit':` before the `default` returning `{ pattern, decisionValues: BLOCK_VALUES, fields: ['reason','additionalContext','sessionTitle'] }`. Do NOT add the field to the shared `top-level` default at :161-163 — that default serves all nine `TOP_LEVEL_BLOCK_EVENTS` (:40-50) and the docs give `sessionTitle` to UserPromptSubmit (and SessionStart) only; putting it in the default hands Stop, PreCompact, ConfigChange and PostToolBatch a rename authority no page grants.

Add `const sessionTitle = next.sessionTitle ?? current.sessionTitle;` and `...(sessionTitle ? { sessionTitle } : {})` to the returned object at :1809-1817 — last-writer-wins, matching `updatedInput`/`updatedToolOutput`. Without this the field survives a single hook (`if (!current) return next`, :1779) and vanishes as soon as a second hook matches the event or a native result merges with a plugin one. `automation-system.ts:mergePreToolUseDecisions` (:76-96) spreads `{...current, ...next}` and needs no change. If the Claude-SDK forwarding half is taken, extend the `UserPromptSubmit` branch at :1696-1704 to pass `sessionTitle` through `hookSpecificOutput`.

Add `onSessionTitle: ((title: string) => void) | null = null;` beside `onPlanSubmitted`/`onAuthRequest` (:451-452). This is the existing facade-wiring pattern for agent→host effects and needs no new IPC.

Widen the return type from `{ blocked: string } | { additionalContext?: string }` to also carry `sessionTitle?: string`, collected from `outcome?.decision?.sessionTitle` on the `UserPromptSubmit` iteration only (the loop at :6418 also runs `UserPromptExpansion`, which the docs give no such field). At the caller (:6566) invoke `this.onSessionTitle?.(title)` on the non-blocked path; a block wins outright — an erased prompt has no title to name a session after.

`promptResult` is read for `reason` (:462-464) and `additionalContext` (:470) only; add `this.onSessionTitle?.(promptResult?.decision?.sessionTitle)` after the block check, guarded on a non-empty trimmed value.
Same one-call addition after the block check at :275-277, reading `promptResult?.decision?.sessionTitle`.

change.symbol: agent callback wiring (~:12750); new applyHookSessionTitle; ManagedSession (:1172); generateTitle (:17619-17628); sendMessage first-title block (:15295-15321)
change.what: Wire `managed.agent.onSessionTitle = title => this.applyHookSessionTitle(managed, title)` next to the existing `onPlanSubmitted`/`onAuthRequest` assignments at :12750-12754. `applyHookSessionTitle` runs the value through `sanitizeForTitle` (packages/server-core/src/domain/title-sanitizer.ts:10), trims to the same budget the auto-title uses (50 chars + ellipsis, :15308), no-ops on empty, then delegates to `renameSession` (:14112-14127) so persistence, the `title_generated` event and the watcher poke stay on one path. Add a runtime-only flag to `ManagedSession` (:1172), e.g. `titleSetExplicitly?: boolean`, set by `applyHookSessionTitle` and by `renameSession`, and gate the two auto-title writers on it: `generateTitle`'s `managed.name = title` (:17620) must become a no-op when the flag is set, and the first-message initial title (:15295) should not fight a title the hook already set. Without this guard the hook title is visibly overwritten a few seconds later by the LLM title.

Two cases, no more: positive — `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","sessionTitle":"auth-refactor"}}` survives `parseHookOutputForEvent(stdout, 'UserPromptSubmit')` with the title on `payload.sessionTitle`; negative — the same stdout projected for a sibling `top-level` event (`Stop` or `PostToolBatch`) drops the field, which is the assertion that stops the shared default at hook-decision-contract.ts:161-163 from being widened later.

blastRadius: `parseHookOutputForEvent` (hook-command.ts:464) has 8 callers across packages/shared/src/automations/automation-system.ts, packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts and packages/shared/src/automations/index.ts, covered by packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.test.ts and hook-decision-contract.test.ts; `parseHookCommandOutput` has 7 callers in the same three files; `projectHookDecisionForEvent` has 7. `PreToolUseDecision` is the one decision object every hook consumer reads, so the per-event surface table is the only thing keeping the new key off the other events — adding it to `surfaceFor`'s shared `top-level` default instead of a dedicated case would leak a rename authority to eight more events. Both hook origins are covered by the same parser, so imported Claude/Codex plugin hooks (`executePluginHookAutomations`) and stored native automations gain the field together. PERSISTENCE BOUNDARY, explicitly: `renameSession` writes `managed.name` through `persistSession` into the session record and notifies the config watcher (SessionManager.ts:14116-14125), and the new `titleSetExplicitly` flag changes when `generateTitle` may write — this is a repo risk trigger. PACKAGE BOUNDARY: shared → server-core via a new `BaseAgent` callback, the same seam as `onPlanSubmitted`. NO new wire type is needed — `{ type: 'title_generated'; sessionId; title }` already exists at packages/shared/src/protocol/dto.ts:373 and the renderer already consumes it. The Claude backend is the one asymmetry: `grep -an 'UserPromptSubmit' packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts` → 0 hits, because its hooks return through `automationResultToSdkHookResult` into the SDK; forwarding `sessionTitle` there needs `SdkAutomationCallbackResult.hookSpecificOutput` (types.ts:911-916) widened AND would rename the SDK's session rather than the fork's record, so it is a separate decision, not a free extra. Do NOT implement any of this in packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts `parseHookOutput` (:241) — it is unreachable in production and a recorded owner decision (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md §3 item 5); a fix there closes nothing.
userImpact: Observable the moment any hook uses the field, and silent when it does. A user who writes a UserPromptSubmit automation, or installs an imported Claude plugin whose hook prints `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","sessionTitle":"auth-refactor"}}`, sees the hook run normally — its `additionalContext` lands, its exit code is honoured — while the session in the sidebar and header keeps the truncated first message (SessionManager.ts:15308) and then the LLM-generated title (:17620). No warning, no diagnostic, no log line anywhere says the field was dropped, so the hook author's only signal is that the name never changes. Users with no such hook see nothing.
